svg.title: scout and self refer to one object
svg.desc: Tag 1: a gray box, the module's namespace, holds the name scout. Tag 2: a gray box, the namespace of the call perform_task, holds the names self, task and minutes. Tag 3: a red box, a Robot object, holds its own names name and battery, with arrows to a str object 'Scout' and an int object 100. Both scout and self have arrows to the Robot object. task has an arrow to a str object 'pick widget', and minutes to an int object 5.
